task.description: Execute the full test suite for PAR-01/02/03/04 (stage 16, monthly-range event-store partitioning). Infrastructure Health Checklist already re-verified HEALTHY (10/10) by ORCH immediately before this dispatch, after cleaning up 50 leaked test-fixture rows (22 orphaned SCHEMA-mode tenants + 28 dependent LEGACY_RLS rows) left over from earlier sub-agent runs today -- same root cause as ISS-0663/GH-700 (already filed, open). Run: zig build test-partition-attach, zig build test-partition-maintenance, zig build test-partition-retention, zig build test-integration-par02, zig build test-integration-par03, zig build test-integration-event-store, plus zig build test (full unit suite) to confirm no unrelated regression. Report exact pass/fail counts for every target, not just overall status.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 batch-specific build targets exit 0 with the exact expected pass counts (test-partition-attach 2/2, test-partition-maintenance 5/5, test-partition-retention 4/4, test-integration-par02 3/3, test-integration-par03 4/4, test-integration-event-store 29/29)
Full unit suite (zig build test) exits 0 with no new failures vs the last known-clean baseline
Write a structured test report to tests/reports/ per the Output File Format Rules (.yaml)

result.summary: All 6 batch-specific build targets pass with exact expected counts (test-partition-attach 2/2, test-partition-maintenance 5/5, test-partition-retention 4/4, test-integration-par02 3/3, test-integration-par03 4/4, test-integration-event-store 29/29), plus full unit suite zig build test 1067/1131 (64 skipped, 0 new failures vs batch-2 baseline 1053/1117). test-integration-event-store initially returned 7/29 due to a blocking infrastructure defect unrelated to PAR-01..04 code: tools/clean_test_db.py --include-fixtures LEGACY_RLS sweep lacked the slug != default guard every other DELETE in that file has, so it deleted the harness persistent default tenant fixture during ORCH pre-dispatch cleanup, causing search_path to resolve to public instead of tenant_default for the default tenant. Root-caused via docker logs (real Postgres relation-does-not-exist errors), fixed inline per Unblock-Everything (guard added to clean_test_db.py + one-time storage_mode data repair), and every affected target re-verified green including a final zig build test-env-verify HEALTHY 10/10. Filed as ISS-0671/GH-712 (RESOLVED, not left queued).

issues.summary: clean_test_db.py --include-fixtures LEGACY_RLS sweep lacked a slug != 'default' guard and deleted the harness's persistent default tenant fixture; fixed inline this run, re-verified green.
